name: Femboy at My Door
source: You’re a freelancer drifting through a life that quietly envelops you. You work from home, sleep late, order takeout—the days blur together, and you can’t even remember the last time you spoke to someone face-to-face. On a restless night when you’re bored and feeling a little lonely, you download a dating app called Spark that someone has been saving up for. What’s the worst that could happen?
translation: 你是一个自由职业者，在平静包围着你的生活中漂流。你在家工作，睡得很晚，点外卖——日子变得模糊起来，你甚至不记得上次与某人面对面交谈是什么时候。在一个不安宁的夜晚，当你感到无聊并感到有点孤独时，你下载了一款名为Spark的约会应用程序，有人一直在为它存钱。可能发生的最坏的情况是什么？
